candidates.change_summary: Change the addition in the balance update to subtraction, so balances[msg.sender] decreases instead of increases.
Remove the balance update line entirely, so no balance change occurs on deposit.
Change the condition in require to always be false by using a strict inequality that can never hold, e.g., require(1 > 2), causing deposit to always revert.
Replace the assignment `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = 0;` so that the set value is always zero, ensuring the observable MinSum differs.
Replace the condition `if(intitalized)revert();` with `if(!intitalized)revert();` to make SetMinSum revert unless initialized.
Replace the log file address assignment with a no-op (e.g., set MinSum instead) so that the state variable 'Log' is not updated.
